sessions.title: The Taking the Cathedral of Saint Vitruvio Part I: Feast on This
recap: Characters Elisar, Fen, Jamie, and Morty travelled to the Cathedral of Saint Virtruvio. We convinced the Silver Order to provision us with some healing potions and then got ready to raid the building.

The cathedral is huge, so Morty and Fen took some pot shots at the (20?) gnolls and war dogs we found when we entered. Then Elisar rolled in and dropped a delirium bomb and took out a bunch of the weaker gnolls and injured even more. Then next couple of rounds were more of the same. Elisar wreaked havoc on the gnoll forces with hypnotic pattern and another delirium bomb; the marshals thinned the herd; and Jamie controlled the battlefield with slow.

Once the Warlord of the Feast joined the battle it got really ugly. His epic actions meant that he had a LOT of turns. Luckily for us, one of Elisar’s delirium bombs incapacitated him for a round. Eventually though, Fen was surrounded, the casters had retreated outside of the cathedral for safety and Morty was pretty banged up. Just as Fen was about to go down (bloody, bleeding, poisoned, and restrained) Jamie came through with an absolute clutch polymorph – transforming Fen into a T-rex!

Fen then proceeded to turn the tables on the Lord of the Feasts, chomping down and restraining him in his mouth. He was able to cause MASSIVE damage (whenever he actually hit). Morty kept giving him reaction attacks and plunging bolts into boss. Elisar and Jamie took out some of the minions and fought off a war dog that was trying to spoil Jamie’s concentration. Jamie even healed the T-rex at one point (a first for Chance!).

It looked grim for the TBD squad when the Lord of the Feast stopped trying to escape and started causing massive damage instead. The T-rex went down, a truly f’d up Fen back in its place, Morty caught a poison arrow from the boss that took him down to 1 hp. Elisar rescued Fen by casting corrupted cure, both he and Fen took a level of contamination but Fen healed for 8d6.

The Lord of Feast was on death’s door too, but Fen couldn’t quite get to him (he was surrounded). We knew he regenerated a bunch of hp on his turn and would likely start dropping us, BUT Elisar used himself as bait and took a hard hit that might otherwise have dropped Fen. And, in the turn order just before the boss would have healed, Jamie, the friggin bard, pulled out his wand of magic missiles and used 6 charges, launching 8 missiles for 40 damage! The boss died to a magic missile to the groin (it’s cannon), the party mopped up the rest of the minions, and that’s where the session ended... with the party depleted, the martials on deaths door, and Morty picking up the Phylactery of Sain Virtruvio and relic that is probably best used by Calandil or Wick. The universe isn’t fair!

Next Session: Heal up the best we can and continue on through Saint Virtruvio's Cathedral. We know that something important to the Silver Order is “underneath the cathedral”. So down we’ll have to go.

sessions.title: Storming Temple gate II: Storm harder
recap: Characters Elisar, Fen, Jamie, and Morty finished off the four gnolls on the battlements of the gate. Fen took some pretty hard hits, but Jamie came in fresh and tossed a big heal.

Once Fen drank EVERYONE'S remaining healing potions. the party made our way down to the next floor. A battle ensued with six(ish) redshirt gnolls. Morty and Fen got into a pretty good rhythm and could take them down pretty fast while the casters conserved their precious spell slots. The "Garys" hit Fen about half the time, but in his rage he shrugged off half the damage and hung in there really well. One highlight is Jamie shanking a gnoll after he caused it to run away from him (dissonant whispers).

The next floor was pretty similar, with the tactic of Fen rushing in, recklessly attacking with his halberd, taking out one or two gnolls, Morty comboing with him to take out another one or so, and then the next turn Fen would be surrounded and go ham with cleave and hew. Fen rolled 4 crits. Morty rolled 2 nat 1s. His only crit of the night was against a gnoll with only 5 hit points. The universe isn't fair.

After that battle, Ellisar ran into the portcullis mechanism room. We all thought he was feeling suicidal, but it turned out he was saving a fourth level spell slot and he delirium balled (bombed?) the room - wiping out all the fodder and leaving just three incapacitated and severely wounded beefcakes. Easily the turn of the game. It was all clean up from there. Jamie tormented one with phantasmal killer. He also viciously mocked a gnoll to death.

The party had to do a skill challenge to operate the portcullis, turns out Morty and Jamie are no help with strength checks. Once the strong ass wizard and raging barbarian got the chain winder things unstuck and winding, Jamie tagged out Fen and the two marshals held off the last wave of gnolls sent to stop them.

We had a quick chat with Sir Virgil (NTSR) and the with Cassandra (she said she owes Elisar one). Then we retired to our not-so-secret hideout on top of the arcane clocktower for well-deserved long rest.

Honorable mention for coolest turn/round goes to Fen with a FIVE attack round. He hit a gnoll, cleaved into another, got a crit, hewed into another. Then used his extra attack for number four. Morty gave him a battlefield command to use his reaction to hit and kill his third gnoll of the round.
Next Session: Take (and loot!) Saint Virtruvio's Cathedral. We'll have to play it smart if we plan on keeping whatever relics we might find there.

sessions.title: The Battle of Temple Gate
recap: Our heroes started the session aboard griffons as they flew towards Temple Gate. Upon their approach they were attacked by ballistae and the Griffon with Cassandra Wyatt and Calendil was killed. As they crash landed, Calendil saved Cassandra Wyatt from sure death.

The party eventually, make their way to the top of the gate and immediately were engaged in a very tough combat. After multiple characters falling to zero HP, they were finally able to clear the top and next step is to descend into the gate towers and open the gates.
